principle: Colourfulness and visual complexity together predict a large share of how appealing a page is judged; both have a sweet spot and too much of either hurts.
detect: High colourfulness measured on the screenshot: gradients, several saturated hues, colourful illustrations above the fold.
fix: Bring colourfulness to a moderate level: neutral paper and ink with one accent.

source.title: Predicting users' first impressions of website aesthetics with a quantification of perceived visual complexity and colorfulness
source.author: Reinecke, Yeh, Miratrix, Gajos et al. (2013)
